description: A program or library a feature needs (schema/deps), as a host or an app has it: whether it's there, and how it's installed on that machine.

dep.description: Its key in schema/deps (vte, kubectl, docker, …).

where.description: What needs it: an app's own process, or the host process.

fix.description: The command that installs it on that machine (a check's: readies it; Ollama installed and not running: starts it), or null (another Linux: link).

link.description: Its install page (none for a check).

group.description: The schema/copy key of what Settings → Dependencies lists it under (deps.providers, window.kubernetes, …).

check.description: It's a check of an installed program (kubeconfig, GitHub Account): it has no page of its own.

ready.description: What's said of it while it's there (Installed, Signed in, Running, 3 models), as its host says it; "Couldn't check" when looking raised; null when it isn't there.
